newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian spot natgas prices move higher in West.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas prices move higher in West.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were significantly higher in the West on Thursday as NOVA continued to draft gas off the system and forward months rose, traders said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub was talked about nine cents higher at C$1.72-1.75 per gigajoule, while June AECO was quoted at C$1.68-1.73 per GJ, up at least three cents from Wednesday's trade.
"NOVA was drafting pretty hard, but storage injections tailed off once prices started going up," one Calgary-based trader said, referring to the softer prices by late morning.
